headline: Reserve Bank of India Announces 50,000 Crore VRR Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India will hold a four-day Variable Rate Repo auction worth ₹50,000 crore on November 23, 2026, following a review of current domestic liquidity conditions.
why: The RBI uses Variable Rate Repo auctions as a key liquidity management tool to adjust money supply and short-term interbank interest rates in India.

impacts.name: India Interbank Repo Rate
impacts.why: Injecting liquidity via a repo auction eases banking system cash tightness and stabilizes short-term borrowing costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A ₹50,000 crore liquidity injection by the central bank directly impacts banking system liquidity and short-term rupee yields.
